static_observations_not_performance_resu.instruction_count_method: Count disassembled instruction lines within each named function; includes all branch paths, excludes other functions; not dynamic instruction count or cycles.
static_observations_not_performance_resu.observation: Oak vector reductions use callee-saved SIMD registers and a stack-mediated horizontal reduction; C/Rust use stackless vector loops and ADDV/ADDP horizontal reductions. Zig uses scalar loops for this profile.
static_observations_not_performance_resu.bounded_next_optimization_to_investigate: Prove an in-register horizontal-reduction alternative for Oak sum32 under the existing modular semantics and checker. Do not relax proof admission or infer speedup from the smaller code shape; validate on the prepared boundary cases and quiet-host timings.
